head: e9f7e73a
question: Can O11's startup volumeBase flicker be reproduced on the shipped artifact, and does a minimal publication-time admission remove the 100 / idle repaints without breaking the Douyin video-to-live takeover?
method: Headful local Chrome 157.0.8103.39 with a throwaway copy of the signed-in Douyin profile; production dist loaded via CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked; chrome.storage.onChanged records every published control snapshot from before navigation through a fully passive window (15s portal probe / 9s gated case). No popup, hotkey, snapshot write or control intent is issued before the passive window ends.
scope: One local Windows Chrome 157 session on 2026-11-15; signed-in www.douyin.com portal and public live.douyin.com; no cookie values recorded.

artifact.source: rebuilt from the modified working tree with bun run build

repair.description: A pure helper preserveAcknowledgedVolumeBase keeps the last acknowledged volumeBase when an observation publication carries either a retired idle field or a new target's unconfirmed default of 100. mergeSnapshotPublication adds one call. Control intents, ordinary reads and non-observation publications are untouched.
unchanged: content-side media selection and geometry admission in media-registry.ts
8c644981 reprojectReleasedSource self-heal and its activeMedia empty trigger
all smoke assertions (three new ones added, none relaxed)

unitTest.coverage: retired idle, new-target default 100, confirmed new value, unchanged target 100, non-observation publication, no acknowledged value

baseline.historical: 11-14 report section 7 recorded 3 volumeBase=100 and 5 idle writes, all repaired by the 8c644981 automatic reprojection to media:2:1 / 60
baseline.note: The 100 in both runs came from a short-lived media:2:2 selection; the idle writes came from its source release. Both returned to media:1:1 / 50.

assertionsAdded: sampler observed at least one publication (anti-empty-run guard)

postRepairPortalRuns.note: Every publication was 100 on the same media:2:1 target; 100 was the page's own level, not a flicker.
A 0 -> 100 -> 50 sequence during portal SPA source replacement. idle is gone, but the intermediate 100 remains, so O11 is not fully eliminated.
Excluded, not counted as a pass: the portal stayed on the unredirected root path with one unlaid-out media element and mounted no control snapshot. Adds an element-level witness sampler to the probe.

failedControl.attempt: Pre-repair A/B on the same gated spec after reverting the two product files, rebuilding dist, then restoring the repair and rebuilding again
failedControl.outcome: The before-run failed after 132s waiting for 'Douyin mounts a playing live stream with an audio track'. No same-scene before/after pair was obtained.
failedControl.classification: Site-side load variance, not an assertion failure. The final dist was restored to the repair build and its seven hashes match the acceptance run.

gates.lint: Strict Biome 495 files, 0 diagnostics, 0 silent handlers
gates.verify: 6 timing timeouts at a 5000ms threshold while only 3.5 GB RAM was free; single-file diagnostics with a 15s timeout: 15 pass / 0 fail / 27 expect()
gates.isolatedUnitSuite: 4 timing timeouts at concurrency 8 under the same memory pressure; the same 4 files run with a 15s diagnostic timeout: 117 pass / 0 fail / 485 expect()
gates.docs:check: rerun after this evidence file was archived; the only prior failures were three links pointing at this missing file

notEvidenceFor: elimination of O11 on the portal SPA source-replacement path
a same-scene pre-repair gated A/B comparison
boost > 100 or the Huya 0.944 physical ceiling
anonymous or headless Douyin portal behaviour
other rooms, viewports or player versions
competingExplanation: The post-repair 0/0 gated run could be a quiet page load rather than the repair's effect. It is therefore combined with the pre-repair portal baseline, the six unit tests on the admission helper and the unchanged final value, not read as a standalone causal proof.
selectionBias: A signed-in headful profile copy on one Windows machine; anonymous profiles are captcha-blocked and cannot supply the same scene.
decision: Record O11 as partially closed: idle repaints are removed and the gated live-room takeover is clean, but the portal SPA intermediate 100 remains. Do not mark O11 resolved and do not relax any assertion.
revalidationTrigger: Control snapshot publication path, Douyin portal SPA source lifecycle, Douyin risk-control behaviour, or the local Chrome major version changes.
